newsitem.title: USA: United Airlines raised fares due to strong demand.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines raised fares due to strong demand.

text.p: UAL Corp's United Airlines said it launched a three percent fare increase due to strong demand, prompting other carriers to also increase ticket prices.
"United started it and everybody has matched," UAL spokesman Tony Molinaro said. United said it raised fares last Wednesday.

Carriers such as Continental Airlines Inc, US Airways Group Inc and Trans World Airlines Inc said they followed United's lead, raising leisure fares in most markets. The higher fares went into effect on Friday or over the weekend, the airlines said.
Northwest Airlines and AMR Corp did not immediately comment on whether or not they had raised fares.
